It reports limits of detection (LODs) for only P. aeruginosa and L. monocytogenes, and in each case CD gave a lower LOD than UV–vis. For P. aeruginosa: LOD of OD600 =0.0034 (CD,[1] Fig. S17a) versus 0.0066 (UV–vis, Fig. S17b)[2]. For L. monocytogenes: presented an LOD of 0.0123 (CD, Fig. S17c) versus 0.0125 (UV–vis,[3] Fig. S17d). Any E. coli value may be in the supplementary material, which this document doesn't include.
